Load libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(ggfortify) 
source("src/utils.R")
```

Load data
```{r}
mega_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/Table_mega_cluster_mm2.csv")
entropy_clusters = read.csv("../input/raw_files/table_entropy_mega_cluster.csv") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Spatial_cluster != "cDC1+") 
```

CD8 enrichment in megaclusters (68 patients)
```{r}
p <- ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = Spatial_cluster)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.7, scale = "width") +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, color = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters",
       x = "Megaclusters",
       y = "Entropy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Print the plot to view in R
print(p)

# Save as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = "CD8_enrichment_megaclusters.svg",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = "svg"
)
```

CD8 enrichment per megacluster comparing response information (68 patients)
```{r}
p <- ggplot(entropy_clusters, aes(x = Spatial_cluster, y = Value_entropy, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8 enrichment across megaclusters by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Entropy"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# Show plot in R
print(p)

# Save as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = "CD8_enrichment_megaclusters_by_Response.svg",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = "svg"
)
```

Megaclusters density per megacluster comparing response (68 patients)
```{r}
p = ggplot(mega_clusters, aes(x = Cluster_type, y = Nombre_cluster_type_mm2, fill = R.NR)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.5, color = "black", 
              position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.8)) +
  ggpubr::stat_compare_means(
    aes(group = R.NR), 
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    label.y.npc = "top",
    paired = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Megaclusters density by Response",
    x = "Megaclusters",
    y = "Density"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)

print(p)

# Save as SVG
ggsave(
  filename = "Megaclusters_density_by_Response.svg",
  plot = p,
  width = 8,
  height = 6,
  units = "in",
  device = "svg"
)
```

Load data per patient
```{r}
df_density = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_density.csv", row.names = 1)
df_entropy = read.csv("../input/MegaClusters_entropy.csv", row.names = 1)

traitData = read.csv("../input/Clinical_data.csv", row.names = 1) %>%
  dplyr::filter(rownames(.) %in% rownames(df_density)) #Subset to only patients with clinical data

df_density = df_density[match(rownames(traitData), rownames(df_density)),]
df_entropy = df_entropy[match(rownames(traitData), rownames(df_entropy)),]

all.equal(rownames(df_density), rownames(traitData))
all.equal(rownames(df_entropy), rownames(traitData))
```

Heatmap for megaclusters (68 patients)
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Response = traitData$R.NR, 
  
  col = list(
    Response = c("R" = "green", "NR" = "red")
  ),
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)

## Heatmap

## Proportions
dend_column = as.dendrogram(hclust(dist(scale(df_density)), method = "ward.D2"))

ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(df_density)), 
        border = T, cluster_columns = dend_column, 
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), 
        name = "Megaclusters density", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(5, "cm"), 
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(25, "cm"), height = unit(10, "cm"), na_col = "grey90",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


svg("Results/Density_megaclusters_clusters.svg", width = 20, height = 10)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht1,
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left"
)

dev.off()
```

Cluster patient groups based on megacluster density (68 patients)
```{r}
hc = hclust(dist(scale(df_density)), method = "ward.D2")
k = 5
clusters <- cutree(hc, k = k)

# Save dendrogram as SVG
svg("Results/Patients_groups_dendrogram.svg", width = 20, height = 10)

plot(
  hc,
  main = "Patients groups",
  xlab = "",
  sub = "",
  cex = 1.5
)
rect.hclust(hc, k = k, border = 2:4)

dev.off()

coldata = traitData %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Groups = clusters)

```

Remove 2 outliers (patient groups with 1 sample) - (66 patients)
```{r}
coldata = coldata %>%
  dplyr::filter(Groups %in% c(1,2,3))

table(coldata$Groups)

df_density = df_density[rownames(df_density)%in%rownames(coldata),] ## Subset to only patients within the patient groups
```

PCA of megacluster densities (66 patients)
```{r}
# Ensure Groups is in the data
df_plot <- as.data.frame(df_density)
df_plot$Groups <- factor(coldata$Groups)  # add Groups column

# Run PCA
pca_result <- prcomp(scale(df_density), center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# Plot PCA
autoplot(pca_result, data = df_plot, 
         colour = 'Groups',   # column name as string
         label = FALSE, 
         size = 3) +
  theme_minimal() +
  ggtitle("PCA of df_density") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10)) +
  labs(colour = "Patient groups")
```

Megaclusters densities split by patient clusters (66 patients)
```{r}
## Heatmap annotations
ann_colors <- ComplexHeatmap::HeatmapAnnotation(
  Response = coldata$R.NR, 
  
  col = list(
    Response = c("R" = "green", "NR" = "red")
  ),
  
  annotation_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 10), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                 legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12))
)

ht1 = ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(t(scale(df_density)), 
        border = T, cluster_columns = F, column_split = coldata$Groups,
        top_annotation = ann_colors, column_gap = unit(8, "mm"), 
        name = "Megaclusters density", clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2", 
        column_dend_height = unit(5, "cm"), row_dend_width = unit(1, "cm"), 
        column_dend_reorder = T, row_dend_reorder = F,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_heatmap_legend = T, 
        row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16), 
        column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize =12), 
        width = unit(30, "cm"), height = unit(10, "cm"), na_col = "grey90",
        heatmap_legend_param = list(labels_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12), legend_width = unit(12, "cm"), 
                                    legend_heigh = unit(12, "cm"), title_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12)))


svg("Results/Density_megaclusters_split_by_clusters.svg", width = 20, height = 10)

ComplexHeatmap::draw(
  ht1,
  show_heatmap_legend = TRUE,
  heatmap_legend_side = "left",
  annotation_legend_side = "left"
)

dev.off()
```

Survival analysis (66 patients)
```{r}
res_clusters = compute.survival.analysis(features = df_density, survival.data = coldata, group_column = "Groups",
                                       "PFS", "PFS_event", file_name = "Patient_clusters", p.value = 0.05, thres = 0.5)
```

Statistical test to compare megacluster densities between Group 1 and 2+3
```{r}
source("~/Documents/CellTFusion/R/CellTFusion.R")
source("src/utils.R")
coldata$Clusters <- ifelse(coldata$Groups == 1, "Group1", "Group2+3")
compute.metadata.association(df_density, coldata[,"Clusters",drop=F], file.name = "Stat_test_Group1vsothers", width = 8, height = 15, pval = 1, y_min = 0, y_max = 6, ncol = 4, width_grid = 25, height_grid = 15)
```

Save patient group info (66 patients)
```{r}
save(coldata, file = "Results/Patients_groups.RData")
```
